title: Graph Coloring
statementMd:
You are given an undirected graph that consists of $*n*$ vertices and $*m*$ edges. Initially, each edge is colored either red or blue. Each turn a player picks a single vertex and switches the color of **all** edges incident to it. That is, all red edges with an endpoint in this vertex change the color to blue, while all blue edges with an endpoint in this vertex change the color to red.

Find the minimum possible number of moves required to make the colors of all edges equal.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of vertices and edges, respectively.

The following $*m*$ lines provide the description of the edges, as the $*i*$-th of them contains two integers $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$) — the indices of the vertices connected by the $*i*$-th edge, and a character $*c*_{*i*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/32f568a12a1c75e03b845a946cd2491cace9d61c.png)) providing the initial color of this edge. If $*c*_{*i*}$ equals '`R`', then this edge is initially colored red. Otherwise, $*c*_{*i*}$ is equal to '`B`' and this edge is initially colored blue. It's guaranteed that there are no self-loops and multiple edges.

## Output

If there is no way to make the colors of all edges equal output $- 1$ in the only line of the output. Otherwise first output $*k*$ — the minimum number of moves required to achieve the goal, then output $*k*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ is equal to the index of the vertex that should be used at the $*i*$-th move.

If there are multiple optimal sequences of moves, output any of them.
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $*n*$ 个顶点和 $*m*$ 条边组成的无向图。初始时，每条边被染成红色或蓝色。每次操作中，玩家选择一个顶点，并切换与该顶点相连的**所有**边的颜色。也就是说，与该顶点相连的所有红边变为蓝色，所有蓝边变为红色。

请找出使所有边的颜色都相同所需的最少操作次数。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100 000$），分别表示顶点数和边数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行描述各条边，其中第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*u*_{*i*}* ≠ *v*_{*i*}$），表示第 $*i*$ 条边所连接的顶点编号；以及一个字符 $*c*_{*i*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/32f568a12a1c75e03b845a946cd2491cace9d61c.png)），表示该边的初始颜色。如果 $*c*_{*i*}$ 等于 '`R`'，则该边初始为红色；否则，$*c*_{*i*}$ 等于 '`B`'，该边初始为蓝色。保证不存在自环和重边。

## 输出格式

如果无法使所有边的颜色相同，则在输出的唯一一行中输出 $- 1$。否则，首先输出 $*k*$，表示达到目标所需的最少操作次数；然后输出 $*k*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 次操作所选择的顶点编号。

如果存在多组最优操作序列，输出其中任意一组即可。
